comment: The Peacock Jharokha is an absolute showstopper in our living room! The carved wood arch and mirror relief are royal and flawless. Packing was super secure.
Stunning craftsmanship! The peacock artwork combined with Kutchi Lippan mirrors gives genuine Rajasthani palace vibes. 100% worth every rupee.
The Lotus Mandala has completely elevated our pooja room ambience. The symmetrical clay coils and mirrors sparkle beautifully in ambient light.
The Teal and Gold combination is mesmerizing! Looks even better in person than the pictures. Received well packaged in wooden reinforcement.
Vibrant festive colours on the Utsav mandala panel. Perfect 8x8 size for creating an art cluster in our corridor.
Rajsi Kamal is so delicately sculpted. You can feel the handmade texture and love in every single petal.
Put this Evil Eye Lippan piece right above our front door. High quality mirrors, heavy board, and gorgeous cobalt blue shades.
The Neel Tara star symmetry is brilliant. Murli Prasad's clay line control is simply mastery.
Ordered 5 pieces of this Swastik mini art for housewarming return gifts. Every guest loved the sacred mirror detailing!
Laxmi Charan mini art in our mandir looks so auspicious and divine. Bright red and glistening mirrors.
Lord Ganesha mini frame is perfect for my car dashboard and office table. Very neatly finished clay relief.
Jai Jagannath! The sacred round eyes sculpted with Kutchi Lippan craft is very unique and devotional.
Warli tribal folk dancers crafted in miniature Lippan relief. Very charming piece on natural wood base.
Matsya Rang has lovely aquatic colors and smooth scales. Looks wonderful next to our indoor water fountain.
Shubh Labh pair arrived well packed. Installed on our entrance door for Diwali preparation. Looks grand!
Jai Shree Shyam! This Khatu Shyam Baba temple mini decor brings immense peace to our home altar. Beautiful Mor Pankh work.
